test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sells an article to B at 20% loss, who further sells it to C at 18% profit. Later on, C sells it to D at 10% profit. If C has a profit of ₹944, then how much is the loss to A?
solution:
**Given:**

 A sells at a losss of 20%

B sells at a profit of 18%

C sells at a profit of 10%

C's profit = Rs. 944

**Formula used:**

Loss = Cost price - Selling price, when cost price > selling price

Profit = Selling price - Cost price, when selling price > cost price

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price is Rs. x

Selling price of A = x - 20% of x

⇒ 80% of x
